parts.text: How do I troubleshoot an EMV contactless reader freeze displaying error code ERR-PAY-4001 on the POS terminal?

For error code ERR-PAY-4001 on the Toshiba TCx 810 POS terminal: 1. Power cycle the contactless reader and reseat the USB interface cable. 2. Clear terminal offline transaction buffer and restart the POS payment daemon. 3. Refer to certified documentation: [POS_Manual_v2.pdf](https://storage.cloud.google.com/pvelevate-project-cymbal-retail-docs/manuals/POS_Manual_v2.pdf).
